title: On Courage
description: A general, fiction-leaning collection for whenever you need a line to hold onto.

quotes.text: It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling
quotes.sourceTitle: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

quotes.text: Not all those who wander are lost.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien

quotes.text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality, and it is not the man who has too little, but the man who craves more, that is poor. The wise adapt themselves to circumstances, as water molds itself to the pitcher, and yet a disciplined mind endures every hardship without complaint.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Courage is not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela

quotes.text: She was fierce and strong and broken all at once.
quotes.author: Unknown
